description: The six evidence-grounded agent rewrites keeping the Agent/AgentFinding interfaces and the unique prompt markers: Validator (categorized + deterministic jurisdiction-aware checks, never REJECT on completeness), Clinical Consistency (keep AgentRole.MEDICAL_EXPERT + 'Medical Expert Agent' marker; consistency not medical truth), Policy (short-circuit INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE when no policy doc), Fraud (amount-only filter + no-evidence message), Risk engine (produce RiskBreakdown, keep legacy tags), Judge (blocking_conditions kw param + REVIEW-forcing guard inside rule()). Design §8.1-8.6, §14. Depends on FEAT-001 and FEAT-002. Blocks FEAT-004/FEAT-005.
steps: Edit backend/agentcore/agents/validator.py (keep 'Validator Agent' marker): new prompt emitting six categories {DOCUMENT_VALIDITY,DATA_COMPLETENESS,DATA_CONSISTENCY,CODING,BILLING,DOCUMENT_CONSISTENCY} with severity/field/evidence. Add deterministic code checks merged into findings (design §8.1): completeness (MISSING fields; NPI/CPT missing in IN = info), billing (recompute sum, duplicate/negative/non-numeric lines, reflect billing.flag), consistency (admission<=discharge, policyholder-vs-patient, diagnosis-vs-code), coding (enforce CPT/HCPCS/NPI only when jurisdiction flags true), document validity (missing policy/identity doc = warning; CONFLICT = error; admission>discharge = error; BILLING_MISMATCH = error). Verdict mapping: any error/warning -> FLAG; info-only/clean -> APPROVE; never REJECT.

Edit backend/agentcore/agents/medical_expert.py (keep AgentRole.MEDICAL_EXPERT and the literal 'Medical Expert Agent' marker): rewrite prompt to assess consistency (diagnosis<->documentation, symptoms/findings<->diagnosis, code consistency only where a code is present, treatment<->documentation, procedure<->diagnosis), cite an Evidence snippet for each finding, abstain on sub-checks lacking evidence, tags carry consistency labels. Keep AgentFinding return.

Edit backend/agentcore/agents/policy_expert.py (keep 'Policy Expert Agent' marker): if policy_status != PRESENT (read from the threaded form), short-circuit BEFORE the LLM call returning coverage_status=INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, verdict=FLAG, missing_policy_info list; otherwise emit the grounded coverage JSON (coverage_status, coverage_evidence, missing_policy_info, confidence, reasoning). Never fabricate clause text or assume covered/excluded.

Edit backend/agentcore/agents/fraud_detection.py (keep 'Fraud Detection Agent' marker): prompt separates risk types {DATA_QUALITY,FRAUD,CLINICAL,POLICY,BILLING} and forbids price-based conclusions. Code post-filter drops any indicator whose only cited evidence is bill-amount magnitude. When no indicators survive, reasoning is exactly 'No direct fraud evidence identified from supplied documents.' and the fraud verdict is APPROVE; never force a flag.

Edit backend/agentcore/agents/risk_assessment.py (keep AgentRole.RISK_ASSESSMENT and 'Risk Assessment Agent' marker): compute the six RiskDimension values deterministically from the other agents' findings + the form; map any analyst finding that is ABSTAIN with tag 'agent_unavailable' to blocking=True and add role-keyed '<role>_unavailable' to RiskBreakdown.blocking_conditions (failed OCR -> 'ocr_unavailable' marking documentation_risk AND billing_risk blocking; failed Policy -> 'policy_unavailable'; failed Clinical(MEDICAL_EXPERT) -> 'clinical_unavailable'; failed Fraud -> 'fraud_unavailable'; failed Validator -> 'validator_unavailable'). policy_risk blocking when policy_status != PRESENT; billing_risk from billing.flag; collapse legacy 'critical' band to 'high' for overall_review_risk.band (only low|medium|high). Keep legacy tags risk_<band>/score_<x>. Serialize the RiskBreakdown onto state.risk_breakdown (the supervisor stores it; the agent returns the structure plus the AgentFinding).

Edit backend/agentcore/agents/judge.py (keep 'Judge Agent' marker): add keyword-only parameter blocking_conditions: list[str] | None = None to rule(). Inside rule(), after parsing the LLM result, if blocking_conditions is non-empty force verdict=Verdict.FLAG and human=True (overriding an LLM 'approve'/'reject'); requires_human = human or conf_value < HUMAN_ESCALATION_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD (0.80). Keep the existing rule() behavior otherwise and the analyze() wrapper.

Edit backend/agentcore/agents/communication.py (keep 'Communication Agent' marker): draft() uses the final decision; for REVIEW use language 'Additional documentation is required before the claim can proceed.'; never state or imply fraud; return dict with keys email_draft, sms_draft, internal_note, tone, confidence.
acceptance_criteria: Each rewritten agent still subclasses Agent, keeps its AgentRole, returns AgentFinding from analyze(), and retains its unique prompt marker substring (so test mock keys resolve).
policy_expert returns INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE + FLAG without calling the LLM when policy_status != PRESENT.
judge.rule(..., blocking_conditions=['policy_document_missing']) forces verdict FLAG + requires_human_review even when the scripted LLM says 'approve'.
fraud_detection emits the exact no-evidence reasoning string when no indicators survive, and drops an amount-only indicator.
The existing 5 backend tests still pass; all agent modules import cleanly.
verification: d:\ClaimBlitz\backend\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -c "import inspect; from agentcore.agents.judge import JudgeAgent; assert 'blocking_conditions' in inspect.signature(JudgeAgent.rule).parameters" (cwd backend) — exits 0.
findings:
LANDED. Existing 5 backend tests green (~9.5s); judge signature import check exits 0 ('blocking_conditions' in rule() params). All six agents keep their unique prompt marker substrings (verified: Validator 'Validator Agent', Clinical 'Medical Expert Agent', Policy 'Policy Expert Agent', Fraud 'Fraud Detection Agent', Risk 'Risk Assessment Agent', Judge 'Judge Agent'; Communication 'Communication Agent'), each still subclasses Agent, keeps its AgentRole, and returns AgentFinding from analyze(). FEAT-003 behavior checks pass with scripted mocks: policy short-circuit (no LLM) on no policy doc; fraud amount-only drop + exact no-evidence string; validator never REJECT; judge guard forces REVIEW on scripted 'approve' AND 'reject'; risk role-keyed blocking conditions + legacy tags. Full-pipeline smoke (scripted-by-marker call_json) on the synthetic claim yields stage=human_escalation, ruling verdict=FLAG + requires_human_review, risk_breakdown.blocking_conditions=['policy_document_missing','identity_document_missing'], Communication draft REVIEW language, master_form populated (patient Aarav Mehta, diagnosis_codes ['J18.9'], billing flag BILLING_TOTAL_CONSISTENT).

ONE MINIMAL SUPERVISOR EDIT (enabling, not behavior-changing): _run_parallel_analysis now passes context={'findings':[...PARALLEL_ANALYST_ROLES findings so far...]} ONLY to the RISK_ASSESSMENT analyst (Risk runs last, so its peers are already on state.findings). This is the data path the Risk engine needs to detect ABSTAIN/agent_unavailable peers (design §8.5/§14). All other analysts still receive context=None. No change to Agent/AgentFinding signatures, orchestration order, or sleep spacing. The FEAT-002 risk hook (Supervisor._capture_risk_breakdown reading finding._risk_breakdown) is the publish path and is unchanged.

=== LLM JSON SHAPES each rewritten agent expects/returns (for FEAT-005 scripted-by-marker mock) ===

All agents are threaded the enriched agent_claim dict as claim= (FEAT-002): {**MasterClaimForm.model_dump(mode='json'), 'jurisdiction': profile.model_dump(), 'raw_extracted': extracted}. Agents read e.g. claim['policy']['policy_status'], claim['supporting_documents']['policy_document']['present'], claim['billing']['flag'], claim['jurisdiction']['npi_required'], claim['clinical']['diagnosis_codes']['value'] (each scalar is a {value,status,source_document,page,confidence} provenance cell).

Validator (marker 'Validator Agent'): LLM returns {"findings":[{"category":"DOCUMENT_VALIDITY|DATA_COMPLETENESS|DATA_CONSISTENCY|CODING|BILLING|DOCUMENT_CONSISTENCY","severity":"error|warning|info","field":"...","message":"...","evidence":"snippet"}],"confidence":0.0-1.0,"summary":"..."}. Code merges deterministic checks: completeness (MISSING -> info), billing (BILLING_MISMATCH -> error; duplicate line same category+amount -> warning; non-numeric amount -> error; <=0 amount -> warning), consistency (admission>discharge -> error; policyholder!=patient -> info; diagnosis without code -> info; any CONFLICT field -> error), coding (NPI missing -> error only if jurisdiction.npi_required else info; diagnosis_codes absent -> error only if procedure_coding_required), documents (policy_document/identity_document not present -> warning). Verdict: any error/warning -> FLAG; clean/info-only -> APPROVE; NEVER REJECT. Legacy-ish tags: ['<n>_errors','<n>_warnings', <category.lower()>...].

Clinical Consistency (keeps AgentRole.MEDICAL_EXPERT; marker 'Medical Expert Agent'): LLM returns {"verdict":"approve|flag|abstain","confidence":0.0-1.0,"reasoning":"...","checks":[{"check":"dx_doc|symptoms_dx|code_dx|treatment_doc|procedure_dx","result":"consistent|inconsistent|not_evaluable","evidence":"snippet","note":"..."}]}. Verdict coerced: unknown/'reject' -> FLAG (never REJECT; consistency only). Evidence cited only when a snippet is quoted (abstains on not_evaluable). Tags: '<check>_consistent'/'<check>_inconsistent'/'<check>_not_present'.

Policy (marker 'Policy Expert Agent'): CODE GUARD short-circuits BEFORE any LLM call when claim['policy']['policy_status'] != 'PRESENT' -> AgentFinding verdict=FLAG, tags=['coverage_insufficient_evidence','policy_document_missing'], reasoning about missing policy doc (so FEAT-005 need NOT script Policy for the no-policy-doc case). When policy_status=='PRESENT' it calls the LLM expecting {"coverage_status":"COVERED|NOT_COVERED|PARTIALLY_COVERED|INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE|HUMAN_REVIEW","coverage_evidence":[{"snippet":"...","page":n}],"relevant_clause":null,"missing_policy_info":[...],"confidence":0.0-1.0,"reasoning":"..."}; verdict APPROVE only when coverage_status==COVERED else FLAG. Tags: ['coverage_<status.lower()>', 'missing_<field>'...].

Fraud (marker 'Fraud Detection Agent'): LLM returns {"fraud_indicators":[{"indicator":"...","evidence":"snippet","confidence":0.0-1.0,"severity":"low|medium|high","risk_type":"DATA_QUALITY|FRAUD|CLINICAL|POLICY|BILLING"}],"overall_fraud_assessment":"...","confidence":0.0-1.0}. Code post-filter drops any indicator whose cited text matches amount-only patterns (high bill/expensive/large total/exceeds average...) UNLESS it also names a concrete signal (duplicate/conflict/mismatch/identity/date/admission/discharge/unbundl/upcod/repeated/inconsistent/forg/manipulat/phantom). When NO indicator survives: verdict=APPROVE, reasoning EXACTLY 'No direct fraud evidence identified from supplied documents.' (module const NO_EVIDENCE_REASONING), tags=['no_fraud_evidence']; never forces a flag. Surviving -> verdict=FLAG, tags=[risk_type.lower()...].

Risk (keeps AgentRole.RISK_ASSESSMENT; marker 'Risk Assessment Agent'): LLM is NARRATIVE ONLY and optional (wrapped in try/except so the computed breakdown survives an LLM failure); it returns {"reasoning":"...","confidence":0.0-1.0,"notes":[...]}. The six RiskDimension scores are computed in CODE from the form + peer findings (threaded via context['findings']). Returns an AgentFinding (verdict FLAG when blocking_conditions non-empty OR overall band 'high', else APPROVE) and attaches finding._risk_breakdown = RiskBreakdown (plain private attr; the Supervisor's _capture_risk_breakdown serializes it to state.risk_breakdown). Legacy tags kept: ['risk_<band>','score_<x.xx>'] with band single-token low|medium|high (critical collapses to high via _band_from_score).

RiskBreakdown.blocking_conditions KEYS (so FEAT-005 scripts match):
- Evidence-based from the form: 'policy_document_missing' (policy_status!=PRESENT), 'identity_document_missing' (identity_document not present), 'document_conflict' (any CONFLICT field), 'billing_mismatch' (billing.flag==BILLING_MISMATCH).
- Role-keyed from an ABSTAIN peer tagged 'agent_unavailable': 'ocr_unavailable' (also marks documentation_risk AND billing_risk blocking), 'validator_unavailable' (documentation_risk AND billing_risk blocking), 'policy_unavailable' (policy_risk blocking), 'clinical_unavailable' (clinical_risk blocking), 'fraud_unavailable' (fraud_risk blocking). Exactly ONE role-keyed condition per failed role (never both dimension names). Dimensions: documentation_risk, policy_risk, clinical_risk, billing_risk, fraud_risk, overall_review_risk (overall = max of the five, display-only, band low|medium|high; drivers = the deduped blocking_conditions or ['no_blocking_conditions']). blocking_conditions on the breakdown is order-preserving + deduped.

Judge (marker 'Judge Agent'): rule(*, claim_id, findings, blocking_conditions: list[str]|None=None, debate_history=None, decision_path=None) -> JudgeRuling (keyword-only blocking_conditions already present from FEAT-002; FEAT-003 only rewrote the system_prompt with reconciliation rules — never auto-REJECT on missing info, never auto-APPROVE on low risk, REVIEW is worst unilateral outcome). The guard INSIDE rule(): if blocking_conditions non-empty -> verdict=Verdict.FLAG, human=True (overrides scripted LLM 'approve'/'reject'); requires_human_review = human OR conf < HUMAN_ESCALATION_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD (0.80). LLM JSON unchanged: {"verdict":"approve|reject|flag","confidence":0.0-1.0,"reasoning":"...","dissenting_agents":[...],"requires_human_review":bool}. analyze() wrapper unchanged.

Communication (marker 'Communication Agent'): draft(*, claim_id, decision, reasoning, claim) -> dict with keys email_draft, sms_draft, internal_note, tone, confidence (always a dict; {} on non-dict parse). For a REVIEW/FLAG decision the prompt instructs the exact language 'Additional documentation is required before the claim can proceed.' (module const REVIEW_LANGUAGE) and forbids stating/implying fraud. The Supervisor passes the JUDGE's final decision ('REVIEW' when human_review) + rationale (per FEAT-002 _run_communication). analyze() still returns an AgentFinding (verdict APPROVE, tags ['drafts_ready']).

FILES CHANGED (committed on feat/master-claim-form): backend/agentcore/agents/{validator,medical_expert,policy_expert,fraud_detection,risk_assessment,judge,communication}.py and backend/agentcore/supervisor.py (the one Risk-context edit). NOT pushed.
